summary: This program builds a playlist of Song objects in a List, then stores the same songs in a HashMap keyed by title and prints them, and finally copies that map into a TreeMap so the same songs come out sorted alphabetically by title.

lines.text: The variable is declared as the Map interface rather than HashMap, which is what lets you swap in a different implementation later without touching the rest of the code.
Each song is filed under its own title: the title becomes the key for fast lookup, and the whole Song object is the value stored with it.
Looping over keySet() gives you every key in the map, but a HashMap makes no promise about the order, so your output here may differ from the book's.
Passing the existing map to the TreeMap constructor copies all four entries across and sorts them by key as they go in, so no extra sorting step is needed.
